Czech Accounting Localization — full suite

Installs the Czech statutory localization in one step and offers the optional pieces as switches in the settings, and cross-checks the VAT filings with each other and with the ledger.

Version19.0.1.4.0
EditionCommunity and Enterprise
LicenceAGPL-3
Requiresl10n_cz, l10n_cssk_core, l10n_cz_statutory, l10n_cz_kh, l10n_cz_ec_sales, l10n_cz_vat_return, l10n_cz_invoice, l10n_cssk_partner_balances, l10n_cssk_vies, l10n_cssk_accrual, l10n_cz_inventory_verification

What it is for

The Czech localization is split into many modules so that each company installs only what it needs. This module is the one-click way in: installing it brings the statutory core for a Czech company, and adds switches for the optional parts. It also adds three cross-checks between the VAT filings and the ledger (see below).

What it installs

Area Module
Shared core: settings, tax offices, filing life cycle l10n_cssk_core
Czech statutory base l10n_cz_statutory
VAT return (přiznání k DPH, DPHDP3) l10n_cz_vat_return
Control statement (kontrolní hlášení, DPHKH1) l10n_cz_kh
EC sales list (souhrnné hlášení, DPHSHV) l10n_cz_ec_sales
Czech invoice layout l10n_cz_invoice
Partner balances and offsetting (saldokonto, zápočet) l10n_cssk_partner_balances
VIES check of EU VAT numbers l10n_cssk_vies
Accruals (dohadné položky) l10n_cssk_accrual
Stock-taking records (inventarizace) l10n_cz_inventory_verification

Each of these modules has its own guide.

Optional pieces

Accounting → Configuration → Settings, block Czech / Slovak Localization. Tick a switch and save: Odoo installs the module. Unticking it uninstalls the module again.

Switch Installs Notes
Exchange-rate sync (ČNB) currency_rate_update_cz daily rates of the Czech National Bank; Community only
Časové rozlišení (deferrals) l10n_cz_account_cutoff prepaid and deferred expenses and revenues (381–385); Community only
Supplier reliability check l10n_cz_payment_reliability checks an unreliable VAT payer and the published bank account before you pay
Dual depreciation l10n_cz_account_asset_tax tax depreciation alongside accounting depreciation
Method A inventory l10n_cz_stock_account_method_a perpetual inventory accounting (způsob A); delivered in a separate repository
Advance invoices l10n_cz_sale_order_advance_invoice zálohové faktury and tax documents for received payments
Účetní vzory (interní doklady) l10n_cz_account_move_template named debit / credit templates for internal documents
Účetní závěrka l10n_cz_fiscal_year_closing year-end closing through 710 / 702, opening through 701 with the result on 431
Protokoly k majetku l10n_cz_asset_protocol_oca commissioning and disposal protocols for fixed assets
Manažerské výkazy l10n_cz_mis_reports management profit and loss on MIS Builder; not a statutory statement
Vytěžování faktur (AI) account_invoice_ai_extract reads vendor bills from PDF; delivered to subscribers
Účetní závěrka (Rozvaha, VZZ) l10n_cz_fs balance sheet and profit and loss account
Přiznání k dani z příjmů (DPPDP9) l10n_cz_dppo corporate income-tax return

On Odoo Enterprise the exchange-rate and deferral switches are hidden, because Enterprise has its own automatic exchange rates and deferred revenue and expense.

Cross-checks between filings

Before filing, three buttons compare the VAT filings of a Czech company with each other and with the ledger. Each opens the comparison screen of l10n_cssk_core, where every row keeps its figures, its state and your note across later runs.

Where Button What is compared
Kontrolní hlášení Porovnat s přiznáním the eight control rows of the hlášení with the rows of the přiznání
Souhrnné hlášení Porovnat s přiznáním the hlášení by code with ř. 20, 21 and 31
Přiznání k DPH Porovnat s účetnictvím the tax of the přiznání with account 343

The buttons appear once the filing is computed. The first two need a computed přiznání covering the same period.

Kontrolní hlášení ↔ přiznání. The hlášení ends with control rows, and the Financial Administration's structure states which row of the přiznání each must agree with, within 1 000 Kč:

Control row Kontrolní hlášení Přiznání
obrat23 / obrat5 bases of A.4 + A.5, standard / reduced rate ř. 1 / ř. 2
pln23 / pln5 bases of B.2 + B.3, standard / reduced rate ř. 40 / ř. 41
pln_rez_pren base of A.1 ř. 25
rez_pren23 / rez_pren5 bases of B.1, standard / reduced rate ř. 10 / ř. 11
celk_zd_a2 bases of A.2 ř. 3 + 4 + 5 + 6 + 9 + 12 + 13

A difference above 1 000 Kč is reported as a difference.

Souhrnné hlášení ↔ přiznání. The instructions of the přiznání send three rows to the souhrnné hlášení: ř. 20 with codes 0 and 1 (goods and transfers of own goods), ř. 21 with code 3 (services under § 9 odst. 1) and ř. 31 with code 2 (the middle party of a triangular trade).

Quarterly payers. Where the přiznání covers a quarter and the hlášení a month, the hlášení of all three months are added before comparing. If one of them is not computed, the rows are shown as informational with a note, not as differences.

Přiznání ↔ ledger.

Row Přiznání Ledger
Daň na výstupu ř. 62 output tax booked on 343 by tax lines, including the self-assessed tax of reverse charge and acquisitions
Odpočet daně ř. 46, both columns deduction booked on 343 by tax lines
Pohyby na účtu 343 mimo daňové řádky — what moved on 343 with no tax behind it: payments to and from the tax office, and anything booked by hand
Uskutečněná plnění ↔ tržby ř. 1, 2, 20–26 credit turnover of account group 60; for orientation only

The first two must agree within 20 Kč (each row of the přiznání is rounded to whole crowns on its own). The last two are informational: look at the third when it is not explained by payments of the tax.

Limitations

  • The cross-checks are advisory. They do not block exporting or filing.
  • The cross-checks read what is computed in Odoo. They cannot see a filing made elsewhere, and the ledger check reads account 343 by its code.
  • The coefficient rows of the přiznání (52, 53, 60) are not compared with the ledger; no tax line books them.
  • A switch for a module that is not on the server (Method A, the financial statements and the income-tax return are delivered separately) does nothing.
  • Uninstalling this module does not uninstall what it brought in.
  • The setting help for Method A inventory says perpetual inventory is required for audited companies; this guide does not confirm that statement.
